speaker: The Kingsgate beacon
description: P29 (plan M6-M9 §5.7): the short scene when the giant relights the Kingsgate beacon (BeaconFire's scene_dialogue): from the fire the three powers of the Old Kingdom are in view - Brannock, the Greywood's woodfolk and Aldmere - and the oaths that lead to the Stone Throne.

nodes.text: The old fire catches and roars up the tower. Below it the Old Kingdom wakes: bells in Brannock on the Wend, where Marchwarden Edda keeps the March; silence under the grey pines of the Greywood, where the woodfolk fear their trolls; drums in Aldmere's war camp below its fortress. Each power will swear to a giant who earns it. Win two of their oaths, and the giant clans of the Stonehold must hear you at the Moot.
